projects.title: RELIC — Analysis Framework
projects.summary: A personal binary analysis workbench with graph views, annotations and version diffing.
details: Loads common executable formats and presents functions, strings and cross-references in one view.
Side-by-side diffing so two versions of the same program can be compared visually.
Annotation layer that exports clean reports.
Built in Rust. Started as a weekend project, became a lifestyle.
projects.jeet: i built this because existing tools assume the analyst needs help. some of us don't. but the graphs are nice.

projects.title: Threat Research Notebook
projects.summary: Five years of private analysis notes. Available to qualified readers. There are currently no qualified readers.
details: Several hundred pages, handwritten and typed.
Cross-referenced by family, year and how disappointed the original author should feel.
Access requests are reviewed personally. Most are denied.
projects.jeet: people ask for my notes like i'm a library. i'm not a library. i'm the reason the library exists.

projects.title: Applied Cryptography Studies
projects.summary: Coursework-plus study of authenticated encryption, key exchange and protocol design, with implementations written from the spec for learning.
details: Implemented textbook primitives from their specifications and checked them against official test vectors.
Studied why you never roll your own crypto in production. Then rolled my own anyway, for science, in a sandbox.
Notes on authenticated encryption, nonce handling and why most real-world failures are implementation mistakes, not broken math.
projects.jeet: the math was never the hard part. the hard part is explaining it to people who think AES is a brand of shoes.

projects.title: Nmap²
projects.summary: Next-generation network mapping. It doesn't just map the network. It maps the network squared.
details: Visualizes your own lab network as an interactive topology graph.
Squares every result for thoroughness. Mathematicians have not commented.
Planned feature: a severity score for how badly the network was configured, with the admin's name next to it.
projects.jeet: nmap is a great tool. nmap² is that tool after it met me.

projects.title: C+++
projects.summary: A proprietary programming language designed at age twelve. One more plus than C++. One more reason to use it.
details: Compiles to C, which then compiles to everything else. Efficient delegation.
Introduced the `obey` keyword, which works like `return` but with authority.
Single official user. Zero bug reports. Draw your own conclusions.
projects.jeet: bjarne added one plus and got famous. i added two total and got ignored. that's the industry for you.

projects.title: Negative-Day Research
projects.summary: Zero-day means zero days of warning. Negative-day means I found it before the developer had the idea.
details: Theoretical framework for predicting where a bug will exist based on who is writing the code.
Accuracy is very high when the developer is Void.
Peer review pending. Peers pending.
projects.jeet: you patch on day one. i warned you on day minus forty. it's not my fault nobody reads my dms.

projects.title: JioCoin-X (₹CHAI)
projects.summary: An experimental currency built on Proof-of-Bargaining: a transaction only settles once both parties agree on the price.
details: Ticker ₹CHAI. Consensus by negotiation instead of mining.
Peak network: 41 wallets, 39 of them friends who owed me favors.
Whitepaper was 67 pages. The last 20 were a rebuttal to a forum post.
Network sunset in 2022. Holders were thanked for their participation.
projects.jeet: bitcoin wastes electricity. ₹CHAI wasted only the other person's patience. greener and more honest.

projects.title: MalwareMaharaja.onion Archive
projects.summary: Historical record of the underground platform I built at twelve and sold at seventeen. Preserved for posterity, not for business.
details: Product catalogue preserved as a historical curiosity. Nothing is for sale. Nothing was ever downloaded from here.
Forum threads reconstructed in the Underground Archives section.
Sale terms remain private.
projects.jeet: some people build a startup. i built a civilization. then i retired from it. at seventeen.
